meta.hypothesis: RECOMB_BOOST=2.0 destroys autoionisation H3O+ ions via boosted geminate recombination (PHYSICS_DIAGNOSIS §2). Flipping to the physical 1.0 should let more survive and recover the cascade-ion count toward Geant4.
meta.method: Flipped RECOMB_BOOST 2.0->1.0 in src/shaders/helpers.wgsl, regenerated the 10 keV rad_buf dump locally (WebGPU physics, chem off via ?dump=1), counted H3O+ (species 3) and the H2-corrected total. Compared to the production RECOMB=2.0 baseline (E7b).
meta.seed: physics dispatch (deterministic per shader-hash on same machine)
meta.passBar: cascade ions/pri increases vs the 344.6 @ 2.0 baseline (directional confirmation of the destroy-by-recomb mechanism).

summary.headline: RECOMB_BOOST 2.0->1.0 recovers cascade ions 344.6->389.9/pri (0.677x->0.766x; 32%->23% deficit). Confirms RECOMB=2.0 was destroying ~a third of the autoionisation ions. Residual 23% is the sigma_exc=0.5 reduction of excitation events (the deeper two-knob part).

related.chemistry_at_recomb_1_0: E10r (parameter-free): G(OH) 0.914x, G(eaq) 0.858x, 5-species RMS 19.7% vs 18.3% @ 2.0 (+1.4 pp, improves OH/eaq/H).
related.triple_win: RECOMB->1.0 = (a) cascade recovery 0.677->0.766x [this artifact], (b) parameter-free chemistry [E10r], (c) one fewer unphysical fudge. Production flip gated on SSB/DSB revalidation (SSB_P_INDIRECT was calibrated at RECOMB=2.0).
